finish_summary: The tests revealed that bulk_discount_percent thresholds are incorrect, parse_coupon does not ignore whitespace and is case sensitive, Cart.items yields only names instead of tuples, shipping fee logic is wrong (always adding 60), bulk discount applied inside cart incorrectly reduces subtotal, remove_item doesn't raise on over-removal, member shipping discount seems mis‑applied. Also test failures show wrong return types and packing issues. These are all places where the module disagrees with its specification.
